categories.main_business_segments: Changsha Jingjia Microelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the integrated circuit design sector, focusing on GPU chip development, graphical display and control modules, small specialized radar systems, and chip products. The company’s core business includes high-reliability electronic products for graphical display control, specialized radar, and chip design, with applications expanding from graphics rendering to AI training, inference, and scientific computing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in GPU chip design using a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to third parties. It develops proprietary GPU chips such as JM5400, JM7200, JM9, and JM11 series, employing advanced architecture, hardware virtualization, and software ecosystem integration. Technologies include thermal, mechanical, electromagnetic compatibility design, FPGA design, and reinforced display technologies for rugged environments. The company also integrates microwave and signal processing technologies in radar products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are concentrated in specialized markets including aerospace and defense sectors, with expanding presence in general markets such as automotive, marine, and consumer electronics. The company serves industries requiring high-reliability graphical display and control solutions, AI computing, and specialized radar applications. Major customers include large state-owned enterprises and specialized government clients, with a significant portion of sales domestically within China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and main operations in Changsha, Hunan Province. Its subsidiaries and investments are located in major Chinese cities including Beijing, Wuhan, and Wuxi. The company’s sales and operations are focused on the domestic market, with no significant overseas revenue reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jingjia Microelectronics operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on integrated circuit design (fabless model). It outsources wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to external foundries and subcontractors. The company also develops modules and complete systems, positioning itself between chip design and end-product integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing GPU technology from specialized to combined specialized and general-purpose applications, with emphasis on AI computing capabilities. It maintains high R&D investment (over 60% of revenue in 2024), collaborates with academic institutions and industry partners, and pursues a rolling product development strategy. Key R&D projects include high-performance GPU chips (JM9, JM11 series), AI training and inference modules (Jinghong series), and specialized radar systems. The company also invests in ecosystem development and industry fund partnerships to foster innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-reliability electronic products including GPU chips, graphical display modules, radar systems, and integrated computing modules. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. Sales are mostly contract-based with customized solutions for specialized markets, supplemented by broader market sales in general-purpose applications.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jingjia Microelectronics is a leading domestic GPU design company in China with a strong position in specialized graphical display and AI computing markets. Major international competitors include Intel, NVIDIA, and AMD, while domestic competitors include companies like China Shipbuilding Lingjiu Electronics. In the radar segment, competitors include Beijing Institute of Technology LeiKe Electronics. The company emphasizes its technological leadership, comprehensive lifecycle management, and expanding application scenarios to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 466 million, a 34.62% decrease from 2023, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 165 million. Despite revenue decline, total assets grew by over 80% to RMB 7.56 billion, largely due to a successful RMB 3.83 billion private placement to fund R&D. The company’s R&D expenditure remains high, accounting for over 60% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented investment strategy. The company’s net asset value doubled to over RMB 7 billion, indicating strengthened equity base despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jingjia Microelectronics differentiates itself through proprietary GPU chip technology with full lifecycle management and scalable application scenarios from graphics rendering to AI computing. Its products offer high reliability, customization for specialized markets, and integration of advanced features such as hardware virtualization and ruggedized designs. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and strategic collaborations enable it to provide innovative, high-performance solutions tailored to customer needs, supporting domestic semiconductor self-sufficiency and AI industry development.
